slides.headline: 6 AI PROMPTS THAT HANDLE YOUR ENTIRE MORNING WORKLOAD WHILE YOU SLEEP
slides.image_prompt: Worker waist-up at launch complex pre-dawn, arms flung overhead in triumph, two Falcon 9 plumes blazing orange-white in navy sky, SpaceX logo white on bunker. Documentary photo, harsh flash, film grain.

slides.headline: 1) CUT YOUR DECISIONS TO 2 MINUTES
slides.body: SpaceX committed to a second launch just 38 minutes after the first lifted off. "I'm stuck deciding: [paste decision and facts]. Top 3 options ranked by speed. Biggest downside of each. No filler."
slides.image_prompt: Tight close-up of a pair of hands hovering palm-down over a large illuminated commit button, a giant digital countdown frozen at 2:00 dominating the upper frame in bold numerals; cool-blue mission control screens behind glow with abstract green status symbols, all blurred, no face visible. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain. No readable words — countdown numerals only. Accent: electric green numerals against midnight blue.

slides.headline: 2) RUN TWO THINGS AT ONCE WITHOUT HIRING
slides.body:
SpaceX ran two parallel countdowns at the exact same time.

"Here is my weekly task list: [paste]. Identify every task AI can handle without me. Write the exact prompt to complete each one."
slides.image_prompt: Two identical robotic assembly arms on ceiling rails inside a cavernous rocket factory high-bay, each gripping a separate large cylindrical rocket component in the exact same motion simultaneously; warm amber industrial overhead lighting rakes across polished steel, no human workers anywhere in frame, darkness stretching deep behind them. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain. No readable text. Accent: amber-orange industrial light against steel-grey.

slides.headline: 3) REUSE ONE THING 6 DIFFERENT WAYS
slides.body: SpaceX just hit 650 booster landings. Some Falcon 9 boosters have flown more than 20 times. "[Paste content]. Rewrite as 6 formats: email, LinkedIn post, FAQ, video script, Twitter thread, ad."

slides.headline: 4) CATCH 3 CRITICAL MISTAKES BEFORE LAUNCH
slides.body:
SpaceX runs hundreds of automated checks before every flight.

"I'm about to [paste action and details]. List every way this can fail. For the 3 most likely, tell me how to prevent each."
slides.image_prompt: A silhouetted figure from behind leaning close to a wall of glowing mission control monitors, one hand pointing directly at exactly three large red warning triangle symbols blazing on separate screens; cool electric-blue overhead light reflects off their back, no face visible, screens carry only warning symbols and no readable text. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain. No readable text. Accent: warning red against electric blue.

slides.headline: 5) WAKE UP TO YOUR FIRST 3 TASKS ALREADY DONE
slides.body: SpaceX runs 24 hours a day. Systems don't wait for people to clock in. "Here are my 3 morning tasks: [list]. Write an SOP for each an AI can follow with zero questions."

slides.headline: 6) CUT YOUR BIGGEST COSTS WITH ONE PROMPT
slides.body: SpaceX cut cargo costs from $54,000 per kg to under $3,000 by reusing what others throw away. "[Paste spending]. Find expenses AI or a free tool could replace. Name the replacement and yearly savings."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body:
You'll want these when you're stuck on a decision or staring at a bill you can't cut. Save this post so they're there when it counts.

Daily AI news and real tools. Follow @yaffeai

caption:
Swipe for 6 AI prompts built on how SpaceX operates. Fast decisions, parallel work, asset reuse, pre-launch checks, overnight SOPs, and cost cuts. 🚀

Prompt 1 collapses any hard decision down to 2 minutes, Prompt 2 maps every weekly task AI can run without you, Prompt 3 turns one piece of content into 6 different formats, Prompt 4 runs a pre-launch check on your next big move so you catch every failure before it costs you, Prompt 5 builds a standing SOP for your first 3 morning tasks so they're done before you wake up, Prompt 6 audits your monthly spending and names every line item AI or a free tool can replace tonight

SpaceX launched two rockets 38 minutes apart today and hit its 650th booster landing. Their whole system runs on speed, reuse, and zero wasted cycles. These 6 prompts apply that same logic to a business of any size.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: SpaceX
